name: A Donation of Wool
summary: Orgrimmar is accepting wool cloth donations, with recognition promised for sixty pieces. Its stores already have some wool, and the city expects to gather enough from other donors.

sections.title: Wool for Orgrimmar
sections.body: You are asked to give sixty pieces of wool cloth for recognition from Orgrimmar. The city has some wool in its stores and expects other donors to help support the drive.

faq.answer: Orgrimmar is accepting donations of wool cloth.

faq.q: How much wool do I need to donate?
faq.answer: The donation is sixty pieces of wool cloth.

faq.q: What do I get for donating wool?
faq.answer: A donation of sixty pieces earns you full recognition from Orgrimmar for your generosity.
Orgrimmar is gathering wool to support its donation drive.
Yes. Orgrimmar has wool in its stores and expects to acquire enough from other donors to support the drive.
